about_the_game:
Clicker Astro Planet is an immersive clicker that plunges you into a grim yet hopeful post-apocalyptic world. A nuclear war has devastated Earth, and your mission is to lead survivors, restore the planet, and pave the way for Mars colonization. Can you defeat radiation and give humanity a new dawn?

Story and Atmosphere

A nuclear catastrophe has turned Earth into a radioactive wasteland. You gather resources, purify lands, and build settlements, but radiation is a constant threat. Low levels allow steady progress, while high levels can kill. Your goal: revive Earth and unlock the path to Mars for humanity’s fresh start.

Gameplay and Mechanics

Clicker Astro Planet blends simple clicker mechanics with unique features. Click to gather resources, build settlements, and combat radiation. Key features:

  • Radiation: Dynamic radiation levels shift gameplay—from steady growth to urgent defense. Control it with upgrades.

  • Dozens of Upgrades and Improvements: Dozens of upgrades (from water purification to protective domes) with dozens of improvements each, boosting efficiency from 5% to 80%.

  • 4 Random Bonuses: Gain production boosts, radiation shields, or extra resources for a game-changing edge.

  • Background Robot: Automates resource collection in the background.

  • Progress and Stats: Save progress, unlock levels with settlement bonuses, and track success with 10 stats.

  • Music and Sound: An atmospheric soundtrack makes every click a step toward salvation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any with DirectX 9.0 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
